description: This Java class 'DataVolumePeriod' defines a data structure representing the period configuration for data volume limits in a tenant resource management system. It includes properties for mode and number of days, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DataVolumePeriod
classes.description: A Java class encapsulating period parameters (mode and number of days) for data volume quotas in tenant resources.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the mode for data usage calculation.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the mode for data usage calculation.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days for data usage measurement.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days for data usage measurement, throws IllegalArgumentException if negative.
